title: IVG Original Salts Frozen Cherries 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Frozen Cherries 10ml E-Liquid provides a bold and cooling vaping experience that highlights the character of dark, sun-ripened fruit. The profile leads with the unmistakable, rich sweetness of dark Cherries, delivering a satisfying and full-bodied fruit base. This is followed immediately by a crisp, cooling Ice menthol finish that refreshes the palate, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy a sharp, icy fruit blend. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the sharp, icy notes of Frozen Cherries, vapers can explore other stellar options like the vibrant Blue Blaze or the tropical notes of Tropical Ice. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
